card.name: Of/with after co-infected or concomitant
card.fires_on: The small word "with" or "of" right after "co-infected", "coinfected", "concomitant use", "concomitant administration" or "concomitant therapy", where a pair of drugs or infections comes next.

modes.label: After co-infected
modes.description: "with" following co-infected or coinfected, before a second virus or parasite.
